assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached complete equipment emblem. Preserve its exact equipment design, materials, color palette, silhouette details, joined construction and genuinely transparent internal gaps. Change only composition: shrink the entire equipment object substantially, by about 30 percent from its current scale, and center the complete result on the same square canvas. The TOTAL nontransparent object, including every strap, bracket, latch and edge, must fit within the central 55 percent of both canvas width and height, leaving at least 22 percent completely empty transparent margin at every side. Do not crop any part. Do not add any objects or surroundings. GENUINE fully transparent background and all internal openings; opaque equipment and crisp antialiased cutout edges. No backdrop, floor, outside shadow, frame, halo, glow, fog, haze, particles, text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Preserve the hand-painted weathered charcoal iron, aged brass and worn olive leather. This is a smaller, well-spaced game skill emblem, not a redesigned object.
